intro_line: Tanzania's steamy coastal hub of trade, spice and Swahili rhythm.
intro: Dar es Salaam rewards visitors with a lively waterfront, markets and easy island escapes. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: DART bus rapid transit runs on dedicated lanes; Phase 1 links Kimara to Kivukoni Ferry via Posta.
Daladala minibuses are cheap (under TSh 1,000) but slow and crowded; look for POSTA signs.
Taxis are everywhere; agree the fare first, as meters are rare.
Ride apps like Bolt and Uber work in Dar and often beat street-taxi prices.
Driving is on the left; traffic is heavy, especially at evening rush hour.
Walking suits the compact centre; cycling is possible but risky on busy roads.
Ferries from Kivukoni cross to Kigamboni in the south.

airports.name: Julius Nyerere International Airport
airports.note: Tanzania's main gateway, about 10 km from the centre.
